summary: No article was written. The task requires independently verifying, before drafting, what the 'Teacher's Square' is called, where it is located, and what a named Tier 1-2 source actually associates with it -- the backlog's 'Benham is primary source' note is explicitly not itself verification. No repository-held evidence establishes any of this: mount-of-jupiter.md already covers Jupiter's teaching/wisdom association at the mount level (Indian tradition Guru Parvat; Benham on 'religion' as a Jupiterian trait), but no repository content names, locates, or interprets a specific square-shaped marking called a 'Teacher's Square', and a search of docs/source-verification-log.md (Passes 1-17) found no prior verification pass touching it. External verification was attempted via WebSearch plus WebFetch to every Tier 1/2-relevant primary-text host found (archive.org, chestofbooks.com's page-by-page Benham transcription used in prior verified evidence, iapsop.com, www.gutenberg.org, and the exact upload.wikimedia.org Cheiro scan URL cited as working in a prior evidence note), and every one returned EGRESS_BLOCKED from this session's network proxy; en.wikipedia.org was fetched as a control and was also blocked, confirming the block is environmental and not host-specific. This reproduces the identical standing condition recorded for PP-RELAY-046 revision 1. WebSearch summaries surfaced a 'teacher's square' claim only from Tier 4 commercial palmistry sites (destinypalmistry.com, thalira.com, indianpalmreading.blogspot.com), which editorial-style-guide.md Sec 5.1 rules out as citation authority; none of that material was used to source or shape any claim. Per the task packet's evidence-first requirement 8, returning HUMAN_REQUIRED rather than drafting from Tier 4 material or inference. Full account recorded in docs/source-verification-log.md Pass 18.
